turns.question: For outreach messages sent between 20 September and 3 October 2026 that got a reply, what was the 75th percentile of hours between the message and the reply?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: it has no reply-time or percentile measure, so I can't give the 75th percentile of hours to reply. The closest metrics are messages_sent, messages_replied, replies and reply_rate, which I can compute for 20 September to 3 October 2026 if you want counts or the share replied.
